description: This source file defines the ExceptionPatcher class, which processes call graphs to identify exception propagation sequences, fetches context, generates prompts for AI-based code fixes, and interacts with external systems like Redis, GitHub, and OpenAI to automate exception handling and code patching.

classes.name: ExceptionPatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for analyzing call graphs to identify exception propagation, generate AI prompts for fixing exceptions, and interact with external systems for code patching.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ExceptionPatcher with Redis client and repository URL, setting up helpers.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method that builds graphs from Redis, enriches them, identifies exception sequences, fetches context, generates prompts, and interacts with GPT and repository helpers to create code fixes.

methods.name: extract_json_simple
methods.description: Extracts JSON substring from GPT response text.

methods.name: build_graphs_from_redis
methods.description: Loads call graphs from Redis based on the repository URL pattern.

methods.name: enrich_graphs_with_github_context
methods.description: Enriches call graphs with GitHub context information.

methods.name: select_exception_sequences
methods.description: Identifies sequences of nodes involved in exception propagation within a call graph.

methods.name: fetch_exception_context
methods.description: Gathers detailed context around exception nodes, including parent and child function details.

methods.name: format_node_details
methods.description: Formats detailed information about a node, including function info, arguments, exceptions, and code snippets.

methods.name: fetch_parents
methods.description: Recursively fetches parent nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: fetch_children
methods.description: Recursively fetches child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: generate_fix_prompt_based_on_context
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for AI to suggest code fixes based on exception context.
